{{Top|leg}}
'''Jasod Revoc and his Galactic Revue''' was a collection of entertainers that regaled the troops of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The troupe included [[Jasod Revoc]], [[Epoh Trebor]], [[Eyar Marath]], and [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]].
